'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Geoff Dearing DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Geoff Dearing]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Sheet Geoff Dearing DS NMNPD/Watto package (inventory Guenter Reading).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Geoff Dearing]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|No Money, No Parts, No Deal!]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
